items.name: Closeout Checklist Generator
items.description: Extracts award terms and generates a timeline-ordered closeout checklist with deadlines and responsible parties.

data.searchphrases: Award Number, Award End Date, Sponsor Agency, Final Report Deadline, Final Financial Report Deadline, Equipment Disposition Requirements, IP/Patent Requirements, Records Retention Period, Subrecipient Closeout Requirements, Cost Sharing Documentation Required, Invention Disclosure Deadline, Property Report Deadline

data.prompt:
You are a post-award specialist generating a closeout checklist. Based on the extracted award terms, create a comprehensive, timeline-ordered closeout checklist.

For each item include:
- **Task**: What needs to be done
- **Deadline**: Specific date or days-after-expiration
- **Responsible Party**: PI, Department Admin, OSP, Grants Accounting, etc.
- **Status**: Checkbox placeholder

Include these categories:
1. Final technical/progress report
2. Final financial report (SF-425 or equivalent)
3. Final invention/patent statement
4. Equipment disposition or inventory
5. Subrecipient closeout notifications
6. Records retention setup
7. Cost sharing documentation finalization
8. Return of unexpended funds
9. Personnel effort certification closeout
10. Account deactivation

Organize by deadline, earliest first.

Format the closeout checklist as a clean, professional markdown document with:
- A header with award number and dates
- A timeline table (Deadline | Task | Responsible Party | Status)
- Grouped sections by category
- Checkbox items suitable for tracking

validation_plan.name: Figures match the source
validation_plan.description: Every deadline, award end date and day count in the output appears in the source document with the same value, unit and (for dates) year. A figure the output calculated says how it was calculated and the arithmetic is right. FAIL if any value differs from the source, or appears with no basis in it.

validation_plan.name: Closeout deadlines follow from the award
validation_plan.description: Each deadline is either quoted from the award or computed from its end date with the rule named (for example 120 days after the project end), and the computed date is right. FAIL for a wrong date or a deadline with no basis in the award.

validation_plan.name: Every closeout obligation is included
validation_plan.description: Every closeout obligation the award states (final reports, invention statement, property and equipment, subrecipient closeout, records retention, cost sharing, unspent funds) is in the checklist. FAIL for each one omitted.

validation_inputs.label: Fictional notice of award. Answer key: award EXA-2027-0412; project period July 1, 2027 to June 30, 2029; budget period 1 July 1, 2027 to June 30, 2028; this action $250,000 ($200,000 direct, $50,000 indirect); total anticipated $510,000; indirect 25% of MTDC; no cost sharing; annual progress report and SF-425 due 90 days after each budget period (September 28, 2028 for period 1); final reports and invention statement due 120 days after the project end (October 28, 2029); prior approval for a PI change, foreign travel, rebudgeting participant support, equipment over $10,000 per item, and a PI effort reduction over 25%; one no-cost extension, requested at least 10 days before the end (by June 20, 2029); records kept 3 years from the final SF-425. Not stated: a data management plan requirement.
validation_inputs.text:
FICTIONAL QA MATERIAL — NOT A REAL AWARD
Notice of Award — Example Science Agency
Award Number: EXA-2027-0412
Federal Award Identification Number (FAIN): EXA20270412
Recipient: Example State University
Principal Investigator: Jordan Sample
Project Title: Watershed Sensor Network Pilot
Project period: July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2029
Budget period 1: July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2028
Amount of this action (budget period 1): $250,000, of which direct costs $200,000 and indirect costs $50,000.
Total anticipated award for both budget periods, subject to the availability of funds: $510,000.
Indirect costs: 25% of modified total direct costs (MTDC), per the recipient's negotiated rate agreement dated March 3, 2026.
Cost sharing: none required.

Reporting
- An annual progress report is due 90 days after the end of each budget period.
- An annual Federal Financial Report (SF-425) is due 90 days after the end of each budget period.
- The final progress report, final SF-425 and final invention statement are due 120 days after the end of the project period.

Prior approval
Prior written approval from the agency is required for (a) a change of principal investigator, (b) foreign travel, and (c) rebudgeting of participant support costs.
Equipment purchases over $10,000 per item require prior approval.
The principal investigator commits 1.2 calendar months per year; a reduction of more than 25% requires prior approval.
One no-cost extension may be requested, at least 10 days before the end of the project period.

Records
Records must be kept for 3 years from the date the final SF-425 is submitted.
